kicker: コンピュータ支援の証明
title: Unit squares in an equilateral triangle: optimal packings for \(n = 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37\) and \(46\)
正三角形に入る単位正方形：\(n = 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46\) の最適な詰め方
lead: Exact packings give the upper bounds, and the lower bounds show that they are optimal. Each lower bound is a weighted point set checked at the container itself, checked by two independent checkers; all except n = 6 and n = 46 are also checked in Lean 4.
厳密な詰め方が上界を与え、下界がそれらの最適性を示す。下界はどれも容器そのもので検査する重み付きの点集合で、独立な 2 つの検査器で検査した。n = 6 と n = 46 以外は Lean 4 でも検査した。

versions.en: First version: optimal packings for n = 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29 and 37.
Added n = 46 (lower bound: the lattice certificate for m = 10; upper bound: Joshua Wolk's packing with our exact coordinates).
versions.ja: n = 46 を追加（下界は m = 10 の格子の証明書、上界は Joshua Wolk の詰め方を当方が厳密な座標にしたもの）。

versions.en: Corrections from a review: in §6 and §7 the width that stops the next row is at its top (heights 8 and 9, not 7 and 8); in §4 the end of the triple lemma reads √3/2 (v − L) ≤ S ≤ −c‖φ‖₁ ≤ 0 (the leading 0 ≤ was unfounded); §5 states that rows are numbered from j = 0.
versions.ja: 査読による訂正：§6・§7 で次の列を止める幅は列の上端（高さ 8・9。7・8 ではない）での値、§4 の 3 つ組の補題の結びは √3/2 (v − L) ≤ S ≤ −c‖φ‖₁ ≤ 0（先頭の 0 ≤ は根拠がなかった）、§5 に列の番号は j = 0 から数えることを添えた。
